description: Analog partition characterization report: the append-only klt characterize record behind the committed TT/1.20 V/25 C Liberty view, cited for spec row 9 (Liberty corners). The freshness command re-derives every claim the view's provenance sidecar makes -- library name, cell set, the SHA-256 of the config it was characterized from, and the record it names -- so a config edit or a hand-edited view fails the attestation instead of being reported as current. The check is deliberately not weakened to pass.
